component.name: SpaceScan
component.summary: See what takes up space on your drives

description.p: SpaceScan scans a drive or folder and shows where the space goes, as a sunburst chart, as a map of cells sized by the space they use, and as a table you can drive from the keyboard.

ul.li: Fast scans of large filesystems, shown live while they run
Files grouped by kind (video, images, code…), with filters by name and category
Delete, move to the trash, copy and move without leaving the app; other mounted drives are never touched
Text, CSV and JSON reports from the command line

screenshot.caption: Cell view: a Voronoi treemap of a folder

description.p: A cell view shows a folder as cells whose areas match the space they use, with zoom. The sunburst animates, the arrow keys work the same in every view, categories and their colors can be edited in the app, and there is a light, dark or automatic theme.
The AppImage starts on systems without the X keyboard library, no scrollbar covers the path bar in a narrow window, and an optional right-click entry for file managers.

The window opens on computers whose graphics driver offers fewer capabilities, such as virtual machines without 3D acceleration. New Debian and Ubuntu package, Arch Linux package file, and a manual page.
Packaging fixes: icons in all common sizes, and the library licenses installed with the app.
Pick chart categories by clicking the legend, start the app with --category and --filter, and trash many files quickly even with network drives mounted.
